content: Fiɛɛ fì bese saaŋke fin nu ɛkumɛ Diɛw yì nyaa nshii yì to nu wase foŋkɛw. Diɛw yì nyaa nshii yin nu ɛ bese to yuw mwɛɛm mvù yí to jemyi, yɛn yí le bô ɛjisɛ ɛyese, taa no yí nu, kum yí le bô can yese.
Nshii wvun nu ɛ bó to duŋcɛ ɛ bese yɛn wvú le, ɛ mum ɛ no jemyi ɛkumɛ wvú, fewci ɛ̂ ben ɛkumɛ nshii wvù mɛy lo wvun wvù to nu bô Ice, ɛ wvú ke duŋcɛ ɛ̂ bese.
Fifiɛ fì bese to yɛnɛɛ bvuu yuw, nu fí fì bese fewci tɛn ɛ̂ ben wvu lɛ ben ekɛŋkè kentaashɛ beene. Kentaashɛ kesɛse nu ke bee bo Nyo' Ice bô Waa we wvù Jisos Klistu le.
Bese ɛ mum ɛ no saaŋke fin wvu lɛ njoŋ wesebeene enu ɛ wvú ɛ yiŋsɛn.
Wvun nu saaka wvù bese to yuwɛɛ ɛ̂ wvú, ɛ mum ɛ no seŋe ɛ̂ ben lɛ, Nyo' nu n'yuu ɛ kejiwɛ yaa nu naa lo yî ye le kɛ.
Nonɛn, ɛ́ beene duu lɛ beene nu yî kentaashɛ le beene ɛ bó, geenɛn kaa lɛne ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛ̂ kejiwɛ le, tu beene mbiayte lo, yaa cee bii kecɛɛy e kɛ.
Geenɛn, ɛ́ beene cee ɛnte jo n'yuu no wvù wvú nu ɛnte jo n'yuu, tu beene nu enù yî kentaashɛ le wee noo wee, ɛ ɛlɛmɛ ke Jisos wvù Waa we le cuke beene ɛ beene yuule ɛnte jo bibefɛ bisɛɛbeene bicii.
Ɛ́ beene duu lɛ kɛ beene kɛŋke bibefɛ kɛ, tu beene lɛɛle lo bikuu bisɛɛbeene, ɛ kecɛɛy yaa nu yî yese beene le kɛ.

Geenɛn, ɛ́ beene seŋe lo bibefɛ bisɛɛbeene ɛ̂ wvú, no wvú nu wee wvù ké no leeme yî diɛw ye le bvuu gee mwɛɛm lɛŋ, tu wvú nu elɛɛshɛ bibefɛ bisɛɛbeene ecukɛ beene, ɛ́ beene eyuule yî gee disɛɛbeene le dicii dì yaa nu kɛ teytey e.
Ɛ́ beene duu lɛ beene baa ge kebefɛ kɛ, tu beene joo wvú lɛ wvú nu wee mbiay, ɛ diɛw ye yaa kɛŋke bvudvuu yî yese beene le kɛ.
